title: だってビートは止められない

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days after the Arima Kinen…

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki and Trainer <username>, please come up to the stage!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: Congratulations on winning the Best Sprinter award!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: You've had a fantastic year with all your victories in G1 sprints and mile races!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: Now, as this year's Best Sprinter, would you share a few words with us?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much for selecting me for this prestigious award!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I was only able to receive this honor thanks to the many people who kept pushing me forward and supporting me.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I want to thank my fans, everyone at Tracen Academy, all of the residents in my dorm, and most of all…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: My trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Without you and with anyone but you, I would never have been able to come this far.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I would be lost and confused, even now.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: So I want to take this moment to express my gratitude for you properly. From the bottom of my heart, thank you.
choice_data_list: The pleasure has been all mine!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki smiles softly before turning back to the camera.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: With that said, our journey is far from over! Even more miracles await beyond the boundless sky!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Snap!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At the snap of her fingers, fog billows from the dry ice at her feet, bubbles float down from above her, and jazz begins playing.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Until we meet again! Take care!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki scoops me up in her arms, and we make a flashy exit from the stage!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Sorry for pulling that on you without any warning. Are you all right?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Great! Anyway…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'm glad I was able to thank you out there. I wanted to let everyone know.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I wanted them to realize that, without you, Fuji Kiseki wouldn't have been standing on that stage either.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: And I wanted them to know that you're my one-of-a-kind and utterly irreplaceable trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I'm looking forward to our continued collaboration, my dear Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And that's how the curtains fall on the awards ceremony.
